name: aharness-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for @aharness/core (Codex-substrate FSM aharness) and @aharness/test-support.

scripts.build: tsc --build && pnpm --dir packages/web-ui build && pnpm --dir packages/core exec node scripts/postBuild.mjs
scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean && rimraf packages/core/dist packages/test-support/dist packages/web-ui/dist packages/core/*.tsbuildinfo packages/test-support/*.tsbuildinfo
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:no-workflow-terms && pnpm run check:no-stale-stateless-contracts && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/web-ui run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/core run verify:codex-bump && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
